premise: Deer is the champion of the quiet game; Fox giggles, Rabbit's foot thumps, Frog croaks, and just when Deer has won he sneezes, and nobody minds losing to a sneeze.
inspiration: The Silent Couple (folk tale of a contest of silence), turned into a game of giggles where losing is the fun part.
lesson: Losing together can be the best part of the game.

en-US.title: Deer and the Quiet Game
en-US.text: [whispers] Shhh. It is the quiet game. Whoever makes a sound is out. Ready? Deer {deer:pulse} stood very still, like a statue with ears. Fox {fox:pulse} sat on his tail. Rabbit {rabbit:pulse} held his ears down. Frog {frog:pulse} puffed up her cheeks. Quiet… quiet… quiet… Fox's nose wiggled. {fox:shake 0.4} [giggles] Pfff — he giggled. Fox is out! Quiet… quiet… Rabbit's back foot began to tap. {rabbit:shake 0.5} {sfx:thump} Thump, thump, thump. Rabbit is out! Quiet… quiet… Frog's cheeks got bigger, and bigger, and — {frog:wobble x2} CROAK! Frog is out! Only Deer was left. Still as still. He had won. He opened his mouth to say so, and… his nose tickled. [surprised] Ah… ah… {sfx:sneeze solo} {deer:wobble x3} Bless you! said everyone. [laughs] And they all fell over laughing, Deer too. So who won the quiet game? Nobody. Not even the sneeze. [happily] And that was the best part.

es-ES.title: Ciervo y el juego del silencio
es-ES.text: [whispers] Chsss. Es el juego del silencio. El que haga un ruido, pierde. ¿Listos? Ciervo {deer:pulse} se quedó muy quieto, como una estatua con orejas. Zorro {fox:pulse} se sentó sobre su cola. Conejo {rabbit:pulse} bajó las orejas. Rana {frog:pulse} hinchó los mofletes. Silencio… silencio… silencio… A Zorro le tembló la nariz. {fox:shake 0.4} [giggles] Pfff: se le escapó la risa. ¡Zorro pierde! Silencio… silencio… La pata de atrás de Conejo empezó a moverse. {rabbit:shake 0.5} {sfx:thump} Pom, pom, pom. ¡Conejo pierde! Silencio… silencio… Los mofletes de Rana se hincharon más, y más, y — {frog:wobble x2} ¡CROAC! ¡Rana pierde! Solo quedaba Ciervo. Quieto, quietísimo. Había ganado. Abrió la boca para decirlo, y… le picó la nariz. [surprised] Ah… ah… {sfx:sneeze solo} {deer:wobble x3} ¡Salud!, dijeron todos. [laughs] Y se cayeron de risa, Ciervo también. ¿Quién ganó el juego del silencio? Nadie. Ni siquiera el estornudo. [happily] Y eso fue lo mejor.

thump.prompt: a rabbit's back foot thumping the ground three times, soft and quick

sneeze.prompt: one big, gentle, comic animal sneeze, a-choo, warm and funny, not loud
